**Chinese name:** 江苏卓胜微电子股份有限公司 (Zhuóshèngwēi)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The boldest bet by a Chinese design house to conquer RF filters — the last big chokepoint held by Broadcom/Murata/Skyworks — and the financially punish-ing one: FY2025 revenue ¥37.26亿 (-17.0%) with the company's first-ever annual loss (¥-2.93亿), deepening to ¥-3.71亿 in H1 2026 (interim 25 Aug, on revenue +6.2%) as fab depreciation hit. The industrial payoff is arriving even as P&L suffers: the 6-inch SAW line runs at 15,000 wafers/month, the 12-inch RF platform at ~9,000 wafers/month SOI capacity (expandable within existing cleanroom), yield 'first-tier' per management, and the fully-domestic-supply-chain L-PAMiD entered large-scale batch shipment at multiple flagship-brand customers in H2 2026 — so much so that L-PAMiD shipment growth is the core KPI of the company's 2026–28 equity incentive.
:::

## What does this firm design?

RF front-end chips and modules for smartphones/IoT, WiFi-7 and NTN satellite front-ends, plus 6G-stage research.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |

| **Node Sophistication** | 12-inch silicon-based RF platform (switch/LNA, second-gen in volume); 6-inch TCSAW/MAX-SAW filter process; fully domestic-supply-chain L-PAMiD transmit module shipping to top brands — a Chinese first |
